text:
elena_marketing: T-minus 48hrs — final check on the release announce. Need: changelog link, docs URL, canary window, webinar RSVP link + speaker names, inbound lead routing (SFDC queue), and benchmark snapshots for the blog. Can we confirm? :eyes:

sam_eng: Changelog is almost done, pushing final edits now. I'll drop link in a min.

marta_docs: Working on the docs anchor. Expect stable URL in 30–45m. I'll add a short "what's new" section and a few example calls.

jordan_pm: Canary window planned 03:00–06:00 UTC tomorrow (low traffic). Can we keep feature flag on for first 2 hours? @sam_eng

sam_eng: @jordan_pm yes — canary + feature-flag. I'll add a fallback route to the smaller model if latency >500ms.

kevin_sre: Noted capacity. I'll reserve 2x burst nodes for the canary window and watch queues. Paging policy set for oncall.

laura_sales: For inbound leads — route trial signups to "Release_Q2" SFDC queue. Please tag with utm_campaign=release_q2 and benchmark_interest=yes. We'll confirm orchestration in HubSpot and add a Slack alert.

praveen_support: Webinar registration question — will we use our Zoom webinar or Hopin? Also need speaker availability for dry run.

elena_marketing: Zoom webinar. Speakers: @jordan_pm, @sam_eng, and @marta_docs. Dry run at 16:00 PT tomorrow. Please add to calendars. :calendar:

sam_eng: changelog link (staging): https://redwood.docs/internal/changelogs/2026-06-10-release.md — I'll update the final snippet once CI passes.

marta_docs: docs link (staging): https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-06-10 — will flip to prod when release is live. I added a short migration guide and examples.

release-bot: Scheduled rollout: stage -> canary (03:00–05:00 UTC) -> ramp (05:00–08:00 UTC) -> global (08:00 UTC). Canary flag ON at 03:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

elena_marketing: Copy plan: announce at 09:00 PT, blog + benchmarks + webinar CTA. Social cadence: +30m, +3h, +12h. Sales brief + lead routing go out at 08:30 PT.

laura_sales: Got it. We'll watch the queue and set up a Slack alert to #sales-inbound. Also prep one-pager for BDRs with the benchmark highlights.

sam_eng: Small changelog snippet to include in the announcement:
```
- Added adaptive batching with 1.5x throughput improvements
- Reduced median latency by 30% on 8k-context workloads
```

elena_marketing: Perfect — I'll slot that into the blog and announcement copy. Any last blockers?

praveen_support: No blockers from support. We'll standby for post-release tickets and pre-populate common triage responses.

jordan_pm: All clear on PM side. :thumbsup:

elena_marketing: Thanks everyone — I'll post the final announce draft in ~45m for quick approval. Tag me if you see anything off. :rocket:
